runtime: Owned local Miniflare/workerd D1 and R2; native SQLite; compiled ez CLI. No new Cloudflare deployment.

format.schema: schema.json with exact schema SQL and migration ledger
format.rows: SQL-side typed scalar encoding; bounded rows/<table>/<chunk>.json
format.attachments: All referenced file_objects and brand_assets bytes verified against hash/length; original storage keys retained

proofs: Actual exportBundle output downloaded from owned R2; executed exact generated RESTORE.md command with compiled CLI.
NULL, empty string, embedded NUL, Unicode, BLOB, int64 maximum and round-trip real value preserved.
Attachment bytes identical; damaged object and legacy0037 fail closed; existing target refused.
Current full migrated schema reconstructed; 0176 migration receipt retained; transient capture tables empty.
Nonempty auth_first_run, API token and session tables cleared; restored database remains quarantined before atomic publication.
Ordinary source update during streaming leaves frozen prior value; closure and recorded retention erasure purge active typed copies.
Erasure after final object publication prevents completed backup receipt; identical successful replay preserves original completion timestamps.
Two late-R2-write races covered: requeue after initial cleanup, and generation CAS prevents older empty-list cleanup deleting a newer obligation.
scale_limits: Elapsed time is local test wall time, not a claim of remote Cloudflare CPU measurement.
R2 PUTs in the scale case are counted through an in-memory sink; separate full native Worker and real R2 cases cover transport.
413 D1 calls plus small scheduler/completion overhead fits current paid1000 allowance; this does not prove Free50 or unbounded data.

production_read_only_fit_check.privacy: Only table/column metadata, counts and byte-length sums read. No row contents or credentials recorded.

validation.consumer_peer_checks: 12 SQLite/D1 offsite cases and 4 decrypt cases passed at 77e8588f; implementation unchanged after integration.
validation.lint: All touched DB/CLI/Worker source and tests passed.

custody.source: Frozen in D1 transaction; temporary data excluded from recursive capture.
custody.expiration: One hour; minute cleanup purges abandoned rows.
custody.privacy: Formal closure, retention erasure receipt, organization/user deletion purge in same SQL transaction.
custody.partial_r2: Private and not eligible for ZIP/L2; cleanup after one-hour in-flight grace, version-fenced retries; completed historical backups retained under existing policy.
custody.restoration: Offline quarantine; current evidence replay and reviewed release still required.

bounds: 2,000,000 bytes per encoded D1 row; 16MiB per CSV, schema, typed chunk or attachment.
Legacy0037 cannot restore losslessly and is explicitly refused.
No live D1 replacement, production restore, provider payment action, secret export or human walkthrough claimed.
